request.messages: the prompt below, as the one user message

content.thinking:
I've found that licence_verified has no effect on the outcome, since 5.2 sends every money services business to escalation and escalation takes priority over approval, which is already the lowest default anyway. Now I'm weighing whether a licensed MSB with a verified state licence should still go to EDD, comparing keeping every MSB in EDD regardless of licence against letting verified licensees skip it.

I'm weighing an alternative where only MSBs without a verified licence get escalated, and I'm checking how an unknown licence status would behave under that rule. An unknown fact can't be treated as a "no," so the case would likely end up incomplete until the licence is checked.

I'm weighing whether to keep the escalation rule restricted to MSBs without a verified licence, and I'm settling on the wording that treats a "not verified" fact as failing the check. An unknown licence status then leaves the outcome undecided, so the case would stay incomplete until the licence is checked.

I'm weighing a third option: keeping verified-licence MSBs out of escalation while still sending unverified ones to EDD, perhaps by requesting licence documents first rather than declining outright.

I'm settling on two options, since the third (dropping the licence check) amounts to the same as keeping every MSB in EDD. Still weighing how to treat an unknown licence: escalating it would ignore a fact not yet checked, while leaving it incomplete keeps the case open until the licence is verified.

I'm settling on escalating whenever the licence isn't confirmed as verified, including when its status is unknown, since an unverified licence should go to EDD the same way an unknown id_verified does under 3.4. A licence that hasn't been checked yet still means the business goes to EDD.

I'm settling on the wording of the second option, where verified-licence MSBs can be approved instead of escalated.

parsed.question: Under 5.2 every money services business is referred to Enhanced Due Diligence, so a verified state licence under 5.3 never lets one be approved. Should a money services business whose state licence has been verified still be referred to EDD?

options.option: Yes, every MSB still goes to EDD
options.says: 5.2 refers every money services business to EDD whether or not its licence is verified, so the 5.3 licence check never changes an outcome and need not be collected.

options.option: No, verified-licence MSBs can be approved
options.says: 5.2 refers a money services business to EDD only when its state licence is not verified or has not been checked yet. One with a verified licence and no other issue is approved under 5.3. Virtual currency businesses still always go to EDD.

rule.text: Restricted industries (money services businesses, virtual currency): escalate.
